title: Detecting bipartite entanglement with PnCP maps and non-negative polynomials
summary: Positive non-Completely Positive (PnCP) maps are an essential tool to detect entanglement since their characterization is a dual aspect of the separability problem. A recent algorithm proposed by Kelp et al. explains how to generate PnCP maps based on the construction of certain positive non-Sum-of-Squares polynomials. We implement this algorithm in a numerically robust way and propose a working version on GitHub.
